question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: "**feel**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**Feel**" means to experience a particular emotion or physical sensation. (अनुभव करना)

 
 
• **Example**: "*I feel happy when I spend time with my friends.*"
